_note: Golden-path MCP tool (2026-10-20 extension pack). core.mjs TOOLS shape. Answers: tradition -> live teachers -> their exact methods -> guided path -> contact. Reads person.living, teaches_at edges, practice.teachers[]/texts[] (this pack), collections, place.contact.

tools.description: Walk the golden path for a tradition or teacher: the living teachers, each one's exact methods (practices with steps, sources, cautions and needsTeacher), the guided syllabuses that contain them, and where to contact them (official place contacts only). Start here when a user asks 'how do I learn X' or 'who teaches Y'.

id.description: tradition id (e.g. thai-forest) or person id (e.g. ajahn-chah)

tools.name: guide_me
tools.resolver: tradition -> people with living:true in subtree (nearest first via /geo when available) -> practices where teachers[] contains them (steps summary, never full initiated detail) -> collections containing those practices -> places via teaches_at (contact block exactly as published, checked date). Figures/texts return the study path instead (works, texts, syllabuses, no contact).
tools.title: Guided path
